notes:
This version works with the new AppSweet server release that supports several organisations. Update
the server as well before connecting with this desktop. Switching servers or organisations keeps
their local work separate and retains changes that have not been sent yet.

Before installing this release, send pending work, export local copies you want to keep and sign out
of the earlier app. Ask your administrator to complete the one-time local reset for this app before
its first launch. Local data from the earlier desktop is not carried over.

New
- Remember several servers and switch between the organisations you belong to from one switcher.
- Settings → Servers shows each server's connection state and offers the actions needed to reconnect
  or update.
- Before leaving a server, account or organisation, choose whether to send, keep a copy of or discard
  unsent work.
- Inspect, export and remove archived local copies after a server is restored or replaced.
- Choose which organisations may use a hosted Sweet Heart provider profile, with one vault on this Mac.
- Organise documents in nested folders and open linked resources from their cards.
- Mark Todos as in progress from Todo and Today lists.

Improved
- Removing access to one organisation clears its local data and conversations while preserving the
  other organisations.
- Update warnings name remembered servers that may become unavailable with the new desktop version.
- The app remembers this Mac's appearance, supports macOS language selection and introduces each
  organisation's pinned apps on its first opening.

Fixed
- Saved sign-ins recover more reliably after interrupted requests, and offline startup explains what
  could not be checked.
- Archived copies with similar names or creation times remain distinguishable, and leaving clearly
  reports the work kept or erased.
